description: Complete the authorization: pass workId, the BODY_JSON from prepare_site_authorization UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/work/:workId/site-authorization); this server holds no keys and no funds. Free with a valid signature from the poster or the wallet the poster named. The worker can then claim the job once a person has checked their credential; Vealth sends no email, so tell them. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_site_authorization, unchanged.

workId.description: The packet id, the same one prepare_site_authorization was given.
